deploybot: Initiating HOLD and pinning rollout to previous stable `v2.3.0` to stop wider exposure. Reason: reranker 5xx spike.
Maria Chen: Ack the hold. Do we want full rollback or try a quick mitigation?
Sara Patel: Pushing a quick mitigation — disabling the new reranker path and restarting pods, keeping it scoped to staging:
```sh
kubectl -n staging set env deployment/hydra RERANKER_NEW=off
kubectl -n staging rollout restart deployment/hydra
```
Sara Patel: pushed env flip and triggered rolling restart (pods cycling now)
Alec Park: logs looking better already, 5xx dropping back to baseline
Ryan Morales: validating traces, latency stabilized. looks like the new path had an edge-case for empty-batch handling.
deploybot: Mitigation accepted. Resuming rollout from pinned point. New canary plan: 25% -> 50% -> 100% over extended 8m windows. Running smoke checks.
deploybot: Canary 50% OK, smoke tests passing, canary 100% complete.
